author: GoPro
description:
Red Bull Homerun is one of the wildest mass-start races in action sports—500 competitors sprint uphill from the base, clip into their skis or snowboards, and drop into a high-speed descent packed with chaos, tight lines, and all-out intensity before transitioning to the next stage. GoPro Award recipient Erik Wahlberg put on an unreal performance on skis, carving aggressively and picking perfect lines as he overtook an incredible 150 competitors in the 2026 competition and turning total chaos into a masterclass in speed and control. Watch the race unfold with this POV footage captured from his GoPro MAX.
